en: Talks to Anthropic's Messages API and to endpoints that speak it.
text: 串接 Anthropic 的 Messages API，以及相容此 API 的端點。

en: Talks to OpenAI-style chat completion endpoints: OpenAI, OpenRouter, Gemini, Groq, DeepSeek, Mistral and local servers.
text: 串接與 OpenAI 相容的 Chat Completions 端點：OpenAI、OpenRouter、Gemini、Groq、DeepSeek、Mistral 和本機伺服器。

en: Talks to Gemini's own API (Interactions) for chat, transcription and voices: every audio format, Gemini 3's thought signatures carried exactly, its usage with cached and thinking tokens, a voice that streams, Google keeping the conversation between turns, so each sends only what is new, and Google Search on a paid key, its answer shown as Google gave it.
text: 透過 Gemini 原生 API（Interactions）提供對話、語音轉文字和聲音：支援所有音訊格式，原樣保留 Gemini 3 的思考簽名，用量統計包含快取和思考 token，聲音可串流播放；對話由 Google 在輪次之間保留，所以每次只傳送新內容；付費金鑰還可使用 Google 搜尋，答案按 Google 給出的原樣顯示。
note: Note: chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability (kindWords).

en: Phone quality, 8 kHz (about 0.8 MB a minute)
text: 電話音質，8 kHz（每分鐘約 0.8 MB）

en: Full quality (the most data: about 4 MB a minute of speech)
text: 最高音質（資料量最大：每分鐘語音約 4 MB）

en: Stream her voice, so she starts sooner (off: each sentence arrives whole first)
text: 串流播放她的聲音，開口更快（關閉：每句完整收到後才播放）

en: Talks to Gemini's Live API: a voice conversation in one stream, both ways, for Koe.
text: 串接 Gemini 的 Live API，為 Koe 提供語音對話，聽和說同時進行。

en: Talks to OpenAI's Realtime API: a voice conversation in one stream, both ways, for Koe. It hasn't been tried with OpenAI's service yet.
text: 串接 OpenAI 的 Realtime API，為 Koe 提供語音對話，聽和說都在同一個串流中。尚未在 OpenAI 的服務上測試過。

en: Talks to OpenAI's Responses API and to servers that speak it, OpenAI keeping the conversation between turns, so each sends only what is new, and the stored responses deleted when annai is told to.
text: 串接 OpenAI 的 Responses API 及支援它的伺服器。對話由 OpenAI 在各輪之間儲存，所以每輪只需傳送新內容；收到刪除指示時，annai 會刪除已儲存的回覆。

note: Note: the plugin's name, as the Models note (1xx9c0t) says it.

en: Shows a PDF's pages as pictures to models that see photos but can't read PDFs, and draws a PDF's first page for its preview in any browser. It brings Mozilla's PDF.js, about 4.5 MB.
text: 把 PDF 的頁面轉成圖片，交給能看照片但無法讀取 PDF 的模型；也會繪製 PDF 的第一頁作為預覽，在任何瀏覽器中都能顯示。內含 Mozilla 的 PDF.js，約 4.5 MB。
note: Note: "brings" read as the package includes it, so 內含.
Note: a product name, kept.

en: Any other server: an OpenAI-compatible one, a router or proxy, or a server you run. Give its address, and annai looks for what it offers, at no cost.
text: 其他任何伺服器：相容 OpenAI 的伺服器、路由或代理，或你自己架設的伺服器。填入網址後，annai 會偵測它提供哪些功能，不會產生費用。

en: A server that never streams sends each answer whole, so annai sees nothing of it until all of it has come: if long answers stop with "No output started in time.", raise the role's "Wait for the first words" in Settings → Models, and Settings → Voice → "Wait for her first words".
text: 不使用串流輸出的伺服器會一次傳來完整回答，在全部收到之前 annai 什麼都看不到。如果長回答因「沒有在限定時間內開始輸出。」而中止，請調高設定 → 模型中該角色的「等待第一句」，以及設定 → 語音 → 「等待她開口」。
note: Note: Quotes annai's own error (沒有在限定時間內開始輸出。) and the two settings' labels (等待第一句, 等待她開口) as annai's rows write them.

en: For servers that speak OpenAI's Responses API. Keeping the conversation on the server, so each turn sends only what is new, is off here until you turn it on: a server that ignores previous_response_id would answer without the conversation. If one refuses requests, try "phase": false, "nowRole": "user" or "encryptedReasoning": false in the tunables. Give a reasoning model its Reasoning levels on its page; without them it thinks without showing progress, and may run past the time limit.
text: 適用於支援 OpenAI Responses API 的伺服器。在伺服器上儲存對話（這樣每輪只需傳送新內容）的功能在這裡預設關閉，需要你手動開啟，因為忽略 previous_response_id 的伺服器會在看不到先前對話的情況下回答。如果伺服器拒絕請求，可以在可調參數中試試 "phase": false、"nowRole": "user" 或 "encryptedReasoning": false。推理模型請在它的頁面上設定推理等級；否則它思考時不會顯示進度，還可能逾時。

en: Give the address without /v1: Anthropic Messages adds /v1/messages itself.
text: 網址請不要帶 /v1，Anthropic Messages 會自動加上 /v1/messages。

note: Note: 聲音: the Voice ability, as annai's own kindWords (b1qn4p), not the Settings → Voice screen (語音).
Note: 即時語音 as annai's own Live voice (the realtime ability's kind); 語音 here is speech, not the glossary's voice (聲音).

en: For a server that speaks OpenAI's Realtime API over a WebSocket, at this address plus /realtime. Add its models by id. annai gives the key as the browser's subprotocol, as OpenAI's own does.
text: 適用於透過 WebSocket 支援 OpenAI Realtime API 的伺服器，網址為此網址後加 /realtime。請依 ID 新增模型。annai 會像 OpenAI 官方那樣，把金鑰作為瀏覽器的子通訊協定傳送。

text: 路徑存在；那裡的模型能否辨識語音，請用「測試」確認。

en: Turns what you say into text, for a model that doesn't take audio. Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is Google's own; Flash Lite writes it down when asked, for less. Their prices are estimates from Google's rates for audio, about 25 tokens a second.
text: 把語音轉成文字，供不支援音訊輸入的模型使用。Gemini 3.5 Transcribe 是 Google 官方的語音轉文字模型；Flash Lite 也能依指示轉成文字，費用更低。價格是依 Google 的音訊費率（約每秒 25 個 token）估算的。

en: Shiori's voice, a sentence at a time, each sentence one request. It streams: she starts about half a second after a sentence is written, and on a weak connection she waits until it won't stutter. Switch streaming off to have each sentence arrive whole, as other voices do. On the free tier Google allows each of these voices only 10 requests a day and 3 a minute: far fewer than a day of replies, so after the first few sentences the next voice in the list speaks. Prices are estimates per character from Google's rate for audio, 25 tokens a second. Her voice is Sulafat unless the Tunables here name another (it is the warm one of Google's 30; Achird is friendly, Vindemiatrix gentle, Kore firm), and the Style goes as Google's own speech_metadata style.
text: Shiori 的聲音，逐句合成，每句一次請求。採用串流播放：一句寫好後約半秒她就開口；網路不穩時，她會等到能順暢播放再開口。關閉串流播放後，每句會完整收到再播放，和其他聲音一樣。使用免費額度時，Google 對這些聲音每個每天只允許 10 次請求、每分鐘 3 次，遠遠不夠一天的回覆量，所以說完前幾句後，會換成清單中的下一個聲音。價格是依 Google 的音訊費率（每秒 25 個 token）按字元估算的。除非這裡的可調參數指定了其他聲音，她用的是 Sulafat（Google 30 種聲音中偏溫暖的一種；Achird 親切，Vindemiatrix 溫柔，Kore 堅定）；「風格」會作為 Google 的 speech_metadata 中的 style 傳送。
note: Note: free tier → 免費額度, as the zh review settled ("This key is on the free tier" → 此金鑰為免費額度).

en: A conversation in one stream, voice both ways, for Koe (Gemini Live). While a session is open, what you say goes to Google as audio. Free on AI Studio's free tier. Koe speaks with Sulafat here by default (from the Gemini Live protocol 0.2: Settings → Updates brings it).
text: 供 Koe 使用的即時語音對話（Gemini Live），聽和說都在同一個串流中。連線開啟期間，你說的話會以音訊形式傳送給 Google。使用 AI Studio 免費額度時不收費。Koe 預設使用 Sulafat 的聲音（需要 Gemini Live 協定 0.2 以上版本，可在設定 → 更新中取得）。
note: Note: free tier → 免費額度.

en: Models on a llama.cpp server you run (llama-server), or one built on it such as Unsloth Studio or KoboldCpp. Their thinking is switched off for quick decisions.
text: 自己架設的 llama.cpp 伺服器（llama-server）或以它為基礎的伺服器（如 Unsloth Studio、KoboldCpp）上的模型。快速判斷時會關閉思考。

en: llama-server listens on port 9931 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty. Unsloth Studio serves at its own address (port 8888 unless changed), with a key (sk-unsloth-…) from its Settings → API.
text: 除非用 --port 另行指定，llama-server 在 9931 連接埠監聽；用 --api-key 給它設金鑰，或者把金鑰留空。Unsloth Studio 在自己的網址上提供服務（除非改過，連接埠為 8888），金鑰（sk-unsloth-…）在它的 Settings → API 中取得。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. For the model the server has loaded, it reads the context each conversation gets and whether the model reads images (llama-server's /props). For another, set its context window on its page (llama-server's -c, or the context length set in Unsloth Studio), and tick Takes photos if it reads images. llama-server started with --tools or --agent lets in only pages on its own computer: add annai's address with --cors-origins https://annai.guide.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。伺服器目前載入的模型，會自動讀取每段對話可用的上下文長度，以及能否讀圖（llama-server 的 /props）。其他模型請在它的頁面上設定上下文視窗（llama-server 的 -c，或 Unsloth Studio 中設定的上下文長度），能讀圖的請勾選「支援照片」。用 --tools 或 --agent 啟動的 llama-server 只允許本機的頁面存取，請用 --cors-origins https://annai.guide 加入 annai 的網址。
LM Studio 伺服器上的模型。

en: In LM Studio's server settings, turn on Enable CORS so annai's page may call it, and Serve on Local Network if it's reached from another computer. It listens on port 1234 unless changed. If you turned on its authentication, give its API token as the key.
text: 在 LM Studio 的伺服器設定中開啟 Enable CORS，annai 的頁面才能呼叫它；如果要從另一台電腦連線，還要開啟 Serve on Local Network。預設監聽 1234 連接埠。如果開啟了驗證功能，請把它的 API 權杖填作金鑰。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. For a model loaded in LM Studio, it reads the context it was loaded with, and whether it reads images and was trained for tool calls; for one not loaded, set its context window on its page. LM Studio doesn't document how thinking is switched: set a model's Reasoning levels on its page if it thinks.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。LM Studio 中已載入的模型，會讀取載入時的上下文長度，以及能否讀圖、是否針對工具呼叫訓練過；未載入的模型請在它的頁面上設定上下文視窗。LM Studio 沒有說明如何開關思考，所以會思考的模型請在它的頁面上設定推理等級。

en: Transcription and a voice from a server you run, such as Speaches, whisper.cpp or Kokoro.
text: 由自己架設的伺服器（如 Speaches、whisper.cpp 或 Kokoro）提供語音轉文字和聲音。

en: Speaches or whisper.cpp, at the provider's address. Add models by id, or with Fetch model list. whisper.cpp's server takes only WAV, MP3 and FLAC unless started with --convert; without it, set its audioIn to ["mp3", "flac", "wav"].
text: 使用供應商網址上的 Speaches 或 whisper.cpp。可依 ID 新增模型，或用「取得模型清單」。whisper.cpp 的伺服器沒有用 --convert 啟動時只接受 WAV、MP3 和 FLAC，這時請把它的 audioIn 設為 ["mp3", "flac", "wav"]。

en: Kokoro or Speaches, at its own address. Add a voice model by id, and put one of its voices in the model's Voice (Kokoro's are such as af_heart). They take no Style: it is kept, not sent; remove "styled": false from a model's tunables for a server that does.
text: 使用獨立網址上的 Kokoro 或 Speaches。依 ID 新增聲音模型，並在模型的「聲音」中填入它的一個聲音（Kokoro 的聲音如 af_heart）。它們不支援「風格」，風格會儲存，但不會傳送；如果伺服器支援，請從模型的可調參數中刪除 "styled": false。

en: Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。

en: Models on Ollama, with their thinking switched off for quick decisions.
text: Ollama 上的模型，快速判斷時會關閉思考。

en: Ollama lets in only pages on its own computer: start it with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=https://annai.guide so annai's page may call it. It listens on port 11434.
text: Ollama 只允許同一台電腦上的頁面存取。請用 OLLAMA_ORIGINS=https://annai.guide 啟動它，讓 annai 的頁面能呼叫它。它在 11434 連接埠監聽。

en: Add models with Fetch model list. It reads what Ollama says of each: whether it reads images, calls tools and thinks, and its context while it is loaded (as ollama ps shows), else the num_ctx its Modelfile sets. A model that thinks gets low, medium and high; for one that can't think, annai only switches thinking off, for quick decisions, as Ollama refuses a named level for it. Ollama holds only 4K tokens of a conversation unless told (with under 24 GiB of video memory), far less than Shiori needs: start it with OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000, and set the context window of a model not loaded when you fetched the list on its page. Ollama can't be made to call a given tool, so a quick decision may go to the main model instead.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型。取得時會讀取 Ollama 對每個模型的說明：能否讀圖、能否呼叫工具、會不會思考，以及載入時的上下文長度（即 ollama ps 顯示的值），未載入時則讀取 Modelfile 設定的 num_ctx。會思考的模型可選 low、medium 和 high；不會思考的模型，Ollama 會拒絕指定等級，所以 annai 只在快速判斷時關閉思考。Ollama 預設只保留 4K token 的對話（顯示記憶體低於 24 GiB 時），遠少於 Shiori 所需：請用 OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH=64000 啟動它；取得清單時沒有載入的模型，請在該模型的頁面上設定上下文視窗。無法讓 Ollama 呼叫指定工具，所以快速判斷可能會改由主要模型來做。

en: GPT models through OpenAI's Responses API, with OpenAI's transcription and voices, and its live voice for Koe, on one key.
text: 透過 OpenAI 的 Responses API 使用 GPT 模型，並提供 OpenAI 的語音轉文字、聲音，以及供 Koe 使用的即時語音，只需一組金鑰。

note: Note: Chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability (kindWords in src/core/llm/contract.js).

en: The one to use for OpenAI: GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol call tools only through Responses. Reasoning summaries may need a verified organization at OpenAI; without one, add "reasoningSummary": false to the tunables. A reasoning model added with Fetch model list needs its Reasoning levels set, as these models have; without them it thinks without showing progress, and may run past the time limit.
text: 使用 OpenAI 時請選這個，因為 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 只能透過 Responses 呼叫工具。推理摘要可能需要 OpenAI 上已驗證的組織；如果沒有，請在可調參數中加入 "reasoningSummary": false。用「取得模型清單」新增的推理模型需要像這裡的模型一樣設定「推理等級」，否則它思考時不會顯示進度，還可能超過時間限制。

note: Note: OpenAI's docs are English only: 網頁搜尋 as annai's other lines.
Note: OpenAI's docs are English only: 網頁搜尋 as annai's other lines.
Note: OpenAI's docs are English only: 網頁搜尋 as annai's other lines.
Note: Chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability; Chat Completions is the protocol's name.

en: Prefer Chat (Responses): GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol call tools only there. Add models with Fetch model list.
text: 建議使用「對話（Responses）」，因為 GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 只能在那裡呼叫工具。可用「取得模型清單」新增模型。
note: Note: Quotes the ability's own name, 對話（Responses）.

en: Turns what you say into text, for models that don't take audio.
text: 把說的話轉成文字，供不支援音訊的模型使用。

en: Shiori's voice. GPT-4o mini TTS is priced by audio; its price here is OpenAI's estimate of $0.015 a minute. It takes a Style (OpenAI's instructions); TTS-1 and TTS-1 HD ignore one, without an error. OpenAI is retiring all three on January 6, 2027.
text: Shiori 的聲音。GPT-4o mini TTS 按音訊計費，這裡的價格是 OpenAI 估算的每分鐘 $0.015。它支援「風格」（即 OpenAI 的 instructions）；TTS-1 和 TTS-1 HD 不支援，而且會直接忽略，不會顯示錯誤。OpenAI 將於 2027 年 1 月 6 日停用這三個模型。

en: A conversation in one stream, voice both ways, for Koe (OpenAI Realtime). While a session is open, what you say goes to OpenAI as telephone audio (G.711, a sixth of the data of full quality; "input": "pcm16" in the tunables sends full quality), and gpt-transcribe writes it down, which OpenAI bills apart (about $0.0045 a minute) and Spend per day doesn't count. annai gives your key to OpenAI straight from the browser, where OpenAI suggests short-lived keys made by a server: if Test says the key was rejected, or the address can't be reached, while chat works with the same key, OpenAI is refusing keys from a browser, and its realtime voice would need a server, which annai doesn't have.
text: 供 Koe 使用的即時語音對話（OpenAI Realtime），聽和說都在同一個串流中。連線開啟期間，你說的話會以電話音質傳送給 OpenAI（G.711，資料量是全音質的六分之一；在可調參數中加入 "input": "pcm16" 可傳送全音質），並由 gpt-transcribe 轉成文字。這部分由 OpenAI 另外計費（每分鐘約 $0.0045），不計入「每日花費」。annai 直接從瀏覽器把金鑰交給 OpenAI，而 OpenAI 建議使用伺服器產生的短期金鑰。如果同一組金鑰對話正常，但「測試」顯示金鑰被拒絕或無法連線到網址，表示 OpenAI 拒絕了來自瀏覽器的金鑰，這時即時語音就需要一台伺服器，而 annai 沒有伺服器。
note: Note: chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability.

en: One key for many models, free ones among them, with transcription and voices too. Sign in with OpenRouter, or give a key.
text: 一個金鑰就能用許多模型，其中包括免費模型，還有語音轉文字和聲音。可以「使用 OpenRouter 登入」，或直接填入金鑰。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter is the quickest way, and it starts you on free models.
text: 最快的方式是「使用 OpenRouter 登入」，而且一開始會先用免費模型。

en: One key for many providers. Free models allow 50 requests a day (1,000 a day after $10 of credits). Its transcription and voices use the same key: none of the transcription models is free, and Fish Audio's free voice uses one of the free requests a day for each sentence it says. The others need credits you buy at OpenRouter.
text: 一個金鑰即可使用許多供應商。免費模型每天可請求 50 次（儲值 $10 後為每天 1,000 次）。語音轉文字和聲音也用同一個金鑰。語音轉文字模型都不免費；Fish Audio 的免費聲音每說一句，就會用掉一次每日免費請求。其餘的都需要用你在 OpenRouter 儲值的餘額支付。
note: Note: Credits are a prepaid balance (餘額), as the zh review settled; "The others" are every speech model but Fish Audio's free voice, so 其餘的, not only the voices.

en: Photos are stored in your OpenRouter workspace's files until annai deletes them, and OpenRouter's Zero Data Retention doesn't cover stored files. Turn uploads off to send each photo in the request instead.
text: 照片會存放在 OpenRouter 工作區的檔案中，直到 annai 刪除為止；OpenRouter 的 Zero Data Retention 不適用於儲存的檔案。如要在每次請求中直接附上照片，請關閉上傳。
note: Note: privacy: says exactly where photos stay and that ZDR does not cover them. Zero Data Retention kept in English, as OpenRouter names it.
Note: OpenRouter's docs are English only: 網頁搜尋 as annai's other lines.
Note: OpenRouter's docs are English only: 網頁搜尋 as annai's other lines.
Note: OpenRouter's docs are English only: 網頁搜尋 as annai's other lines.

Note: OpenRouter's docs are English only: 網頁搜尋 as annai's other lines.

en: Turns what you say into text, for models that don't take audio. The prices are OpenRouter's lowest; it may send a request to a provider that charges more.
text: 把你說的話轉成文字，供不支援音訊輸入的模型使用。這裡顯示的是 OpenRouter 上的最低價；OpenRouter 可能會把請求轉給收費更高的供應商。

en: Shiori's voice. Each model has voices of its own, suggested in the model's Voice (Fetch model list brings the ones OpenRouter lists). The voice and style set here are Women KatKat, a voice from Fish Audio's library (friendly, clear, young and bright), and a young, cheerful and lively, yet calm and gentle style: every Fish Audio model starts with them, those described below and any added by id (sent no voice, Fish Audio picks another speaker for each sentence). A model added from the list starts with the first warm voice OpenRouter lists for it. Only Fish Audio, Gemini and OpenAI's gpt-4o-mini-tts take a Style; for the others it is kept, not sent. OpenRouter sends MP3 or PCM only.
text: Shiori 的聲音。每個模型都有自己的一組聲音，可在模型的「聲音」中看到建議（「取得模型清單」會帶入 OpenRouter 列出的聲音）。這裡設定的聲音是 Fish Audio 聲音庫中的 Women KatKat（親切、清晰、年輕明亮），風格是年輕、開朗活潑，同時沉穩溫柔。所有 Fish Audio 模型，無論是下面列出的，還是依 ID 新增的，都預設使用它們（如果不傳送聲音，Fish Audio 每句話都會換一個說話者）。從清單新增的模型，預設使用 OpenRouter 為它列出的第一個溫暖的聲音。只有 Fish Audio、Gemini 和 OpenAI 的 gpt-4o-mini-tts 支援「風格」；其他模型會保留風格設定，但不會傳送。OpenRouter 只傳回 MP3 或 PCM 格式。
note: Note: "the model's Voice" is the model page's Voice field, 聲音 (b1qn4p), not the Settings → Voice screen.

en: Tap Sign in with OpenRouter to start again.
text: 請點一下「使用 OpenRouter 登入」重新開始。

en: Paste the code OpenRouter showed you, then tap Connect.
text: 請貼上 OpenRouter 顯示的代碼，然後點一下「連線」。
note: Note: the sign-in code is 代碼; 程式碼 (the converter's) is program code.

en: annai has no sign-in waiting for this code: it was used already, or began in another browser.
text: 找不到等待這個代碼的登入。代碼可能已經用過，或者登入是在另一個瀏覽器中開始的。
note: Note: the sign-in code is 代碼; 程式碼 (the converter's) is program code.

en: This sign-in didn't start in this browser, so annai ignored it.
text: 這次登入不是在這個瀏覽器中開始的，所以已忽略。

en: annai couldn't reach OpenRouter. Check the connection and try again.
text: 無法連線到 OpenRouter。請檢查網路連線後重試。

en: OpenRouter answered with a redirect, which annai doesn't follow with your sign-in.
text: OpenRouter 傳回了重新導向；annai 不會帶著你的登入資訊跟隨重新導向。

en: OpenRouter didn't take the code: a code works once, for 10 minutes. Tap Sign in with OpenRouter to get a new one.
text: OpenRouter 不接受這個代碼。代碼只能使用一次，10 分鐘內有效。請點一下「使用 OpenRouter 登入」取得新代碼。
note: Note: the sign-in code is 代碼; 程式碼 (the converter's) is program code.

en: Nothing was sent to OpenRouter yet: try again.
text: 尚未向 OpenRouter 傳送任何內容，請重試。

en: annai keeps the new key for OpenRouter's chat, transcription and voices.
text: 新金鑰已儲存，將用於 OpenRouter 的對話、語音轉文字和聲音。
note: Note: chat → 對話, as annai names the Chat ability.

en: Shiori thinks with free models to start, so trying annai costs nothing. annai also added OpenRouter's transcription and voices, behind Phone dictation and Browser voice. Its free voice comes first: each sentence it says uses one of the free requests a day the chat models use too. The others cost a little, from credits you buy at OpenRouter. To use them first, move them up under Roles.
text: Shiori 一開始會用免費模型思考，所以試用 annai 不花錢。annai 還新增了 OpenRouter 的語音轉文字和聲音，排在手機語音輸入和瀏覽器聲音之後。其中免費聲音排在最前面，它每說一句，就會用掉一次每日免費請求（對話模型也共用這些請求）。其他聲音要花一點錢，從你在 OpenRouter 儲值的餘額中扣除。想優先使用它們，請在「角色」中把它們往上移。
note: Note: Credits → 餘額 (a prepaid balance), as the zh review settled; 手機語音輸入 and 瀏覽器聲音 as the Roles list names them (Phone dictation, Browser voice): one name for each everywhere.
Note: the sign-in code is 代碼; 程式碼 (the converter's) is program code.

en: OpenRouter opens in Safari. Sign in there; it then shows a code, which works for 10 minutes. Copy it, come back to annai, and paste it here.
text: OpenRouter 會在 Safari 中開啟。登入後會顯示一組代碼，10 分鐘內有效。複製代碼後回到 annai，貼到這裡。
note: Note: the sign-in code is 代碼; 程式碼 (the converter's) is program code.

en: Paste the code OpenRouter showed you
text: 貼上 OpenRouter 顯示的代碼
note: Note: the sign-in code is 代碼; 程式碼 (the converter's) is program code.

en: annai has made a new sign-in: tap it again.
text: 已準備好新的登入，請再點一下。

en: annai has made a new sign-in: tap Sign in with OpenRouter again.
text: 已準備好新的登入，請再點一下「使用 OpenRouter 登入」。

en: Sign in again for a new key, in place of the one saved.
text: 重新登入可取得新金鑰，取代已儲存的金鑰。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter for a key, or give one below.
text: 可以「使用 OpenRouter 登入」取得金鑰，或在下方直接填入。

en: Sign in with OpenRouter to get one key for many models. annai starts you on free models (50 requests a day), so trying it costs nothing. It also adds OpenRouter's transcription and voices, a free one among them; Phone dictation and Browser voice stay first.
text: 「使用 OpenRouter 登入」後，一個金鑰就能用許多模型。annai 會先讓你用免費模型（每天 50 次請求），所以試用不花錢。同時還會新增 OpenRouter 的語音轉文字和聲音（其中有一個免費聲音）；手機語音輸入和瀏覽器聲音仍排在前面。
note: Note: 手機語音輸入 and 瀏覽器聲音 as the Roles list names them (Phone dictation, Browser voice): one name for each everywhere.
Note: 腳本模型, as annai's own Simulate row names it.

en: A model that replies from a script, for tests and plugin authors. It never uses the network.
text: 依腳本回覆的模型，供測試和外掛程式開發者使用，完全不連網。

en: Models on an SGLang server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template.
text: 自己架設的 SGLang 伺服器上的模型，透過聊天範本開啟或關閉思考模式。

en: SGLang listens on port 30000 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty.
text: SGLang 預設監聽 30000 連接埠，可用 --port 另行指定；可以用 --api-key 設定金鑰，也可以把金鑰留空。

en: Add models with Fetch model list: each comes with the context the server holds. Tool calls need --tool-call-parser <name>, and a model that thinks needs --reasoning-parser <name>; without them Shiori can't use her tools, and her thinking shows in her words.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型，每個模型都會帶上伺服器設定的上下文長度。工具呼叫需要 --tool-call-parser <name>，會思考的模型需要 --reasoning-parser <name>；少了這些參數，Shiori 就無法使用工具，她的思考內容也會混進回答裡。

en: Models on a vLLM server you run, with their thinking switched through the chat template, and Whisper models for transcription.
text: 自己架設的 vLLM 伺服器上的模型，透過聊天範本開啟或關閉思考模式；也支援用於語音轉文字的 Whisper 模型。

en: vLLM listens on port 8000 unless --port says otherwise; give it a key with --api-key, or leave the key empty.
text: vLLM 預設監聽 8000 連接埠，可用 --port 另行指定；可以用 --api-key 設定金鑰，也可以把金鑰留空。

en: Add models with Fetch model list: each comes with the context the server holds. Tool calls need --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser <name>, and a model that thinks needs --reasoning-parser <name>; without them Shiori can't use her tools, and her thinking shows in her words.
text: 用「取得模型清單」新增模型，每個模型都會帶上伺服器設定的上下文長度。工具呼叫需要 --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser <name>，會思考的模型需要 --reasoning-parser <name>；少了這些參數，Shiori 就無法使用工具，她的思考內容也會混進回答裡。

en: For a Whisper model on a vLLM server of its own: give that server's address as this ability's own, and add the model by id.
text: 如果 Whisper 模型在另一台 vLLM 伺服器上執行，請把那台伺服器的網址設為此功能單獨使用的網址，再依 ID 新增模型。

note: Note: As annai's own Experimental row names it (遠端記錄（開發者）); Trace is the glossary's 記錄.

en: For developers: sends annai's trace, as the Trace screen shows it, to a server you run, while you watch. It sends nothing until you give it a server and a token and turn Send on. The keys annai keeps are blanked.
text: 供開發人員使用：把 annai 的記錄依「記錄」頁面的樣子即時傳送到你自己架設的伺服器。填好伺服器和權杖並開啟「傳送」之前，不會傳送任何內容。annai 儲存的金鑰會被遮蓋。

en: Where annai sends its trace: a server you run, such as annai's scripts/trace-sink.mjs. https://…, or http:// only for localhost or 127.0.0.1.
text: 接收 annai 記錄的伺服器，由你自己架設，例如 annai 的 scripts/trace-sink.mjs。須以 https:// 開頭，http:// 僅限 localhost 或 127.0.0.1。

en: The server's token. annai sends it as Authorization: Bearer, and keeps it with your keys, never in a file.
text: 伺服器的權杖。annai 會以 Authorization: Bearer 的形式傳送，並和其他金鑰存放在一起，不會寫入檔案。

en: Also send the location points annai records while GPS is on, about one a second on a drive. Off, other entries can still name a place, as the Trace shows them: a weather request's address, a tool's input.
text: 同時傳送 GPS 開啟時 annai 記錄的位置點（開車時約每秒一個）。關閉後，其他項目仍可能提到地點，和「記錄」中顯示的一樣，例如天氣查詢的網址、工具的輸入。
note: Note: a weather request's address is its web address (it carries the place), so 網址.

en: On, what the Trace records from now on goes to the server within a few seconds: what you write, what Shiori says, her tools, requests and errors. The keys annai keeps are blanked, and stored content (photos, long texts) stays here. Off stops it at once.
text: 開啟後，「記錄」之後記下的內容會在幾秒內傳送到伺服器，包括你寫的內容、Shiori 說的話、她用的工具、請求和錯誤。annai 儲存的金鑰會被遮蓋，已存放的內容（照片、長文字）會留在這台裝置上。關閉後立即停止。

en: Also sends recordings of what the microphone heard to the server above: each of your turns, and short samples of sound the level check kept out. Recordings include passengers and whatever is playing. Phone dictation is the browser's own, so annai has no recording of it. A text copy of the screen goes too, at each screen change and when you tap Flag, without what's typed in fields or the keys annai keeps, and never from the Trace screen. A Flag button takes the Trace chip's place in the dock, to mark when something looks wrong. It needs a server address and Send on, and turns itself off after 24 hours.

Places she looks up go to the sources credited in Settings → About. The Trace shows every request annai sends for Shiori: her model calls, her tools and the offline pack.
text: 你問 Shiori 的內容，連同她需要的旅行資訊，會傳送給你連線的模型供應商；你說的話會傳到哪裡，可在設定 → 語音中查看。她查詢的地點會傳送給設定 → 關於中註明的資料來源。「記錄」中會列出 annai 為 Shiori 送出的每個請求：模型呼叫、工具和離線資料包。
note: Note: "her" kept where it reads natural; the Trace is 記録/記錄 per the glossary.

en: Each model key is kept in this device's storage and sent only to the provider it is for. Keys are never put in what Shiori's model reads, are blanked out of the Trace, and are left out of exports, unless you choose to put them in an encrypted backup.
text: 每個模型金鑰都儲存在本機的儲存空間中，只會傳送給對應的供應商。Shiori 的模型讀取的內容從不包含金鑰；「記錄」中的金鑰會被遮蓋；匯出時也不含金鑰，除非你選擇把金鑰放進加密備份。

en: annai has no analytics and no ads. It loads no scripts from other sites: its content security policy lets only scripts from annai's own address run, except code plugins you install, which annai stores and serves itself.
text: annai 不做統計分析，也沒有廣告。它不載入其他網站的腳本，內容安全政策只允許執行來自 annai 自身網址的腳本；你安裝的程式碼外掛程式除外，這些外掛程式也由 annai 自己儲存和提供。

en: With notifications on, the push relay holds each time reminder encrypted on this device, and keeps only the phone's push address, when each is due, how many are waiting, and little else: a cancel code for each, and a note that this phone's push service accepted a notification. Reminders about places (arriving, leaving, nearby) never leave the phone. The itinerary's "leave soon" reminder goes to the relay, with its time.
text: 開啟通知後，推播中繼保存的每則定時提醒都已在本機加密。中繼只保留手機的推播位址、每則提醒的送出時間、等待中的數量，以及極少的其他資訊：每則提醒的取消碼，以及這支手機的推播服務已接收過通知的標記。地點提醒（到達、離開、附近）絕不會離開手機。行程中的「該出發了」提醒會連同時間一起傳送到中繼。

en: Reminders about places (arriving, leaving, nearby) never leave the phone. The itinerary's "leave soon" reminder does go to the relay, with its time: that is worked out from where you were when annai last looked, so it tells roughly how far away you were to someone who also knew your itinerary. The relay doesn't know your itinerary.

On, maps.mail.ru, run by VK, is asked too: it gets the point of each search for places nearby (to about 11 m) at the same time as overpass-api.de, and, when all three of overpass-api.de's servers fail a part of an offline pack, the trip's stops and the way between them. Off, only overpass-api.de's servers are asked.

en: Free search sends your searches to Exa, Parallel or Firecrawl: just the words searched, not your files or your location. When no other reader can read a page, Exa reads it, and so gets that page's address. Parallel also gets a random id for each conversation, to count its free searches. They are free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use what is searched to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of your searches. Behind them, a last resort that stays on whatever you tick asks Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) the same words when nothing else answers; Search via: Off stops it, and so does your model's own search, when the model has one.
text: 免費搜尋會把搜尋的關鍵字傳送給 Exa、Parallel 或 Firecrawl，不會傳送你的檔案或位置。遇到其他方式讀取不了的網頁時，會交給 Exa 讀取，這樣 Exa 也會收到該網頁的網址。Parallel 還會收到每段對話的隨機 ID，用來統計免費搜尋的次數。這些都是免費額度，隨時可能變動或停止；而且 Exa 和 Parallel 可能用搜尋內容訓練自己的模型，所以搜尋時請不要包含姓名和地址。在它們之後，還有一個不受勾選影響的最後備案：其他都沒有結果時，會用同樣的關鍵字查詢 Wikimedia（Wikivoyage 和 Wikipedia）和 OpenStreetMap（Nominatim）。把「搜尋方式」設為「關閉」，或者改用模型內建的搜尋（如果模型有的話），都會停用這個最後備案。
note: Note: "Search via: Off" as the choice is named on this screen; the last sentence names the last resort, with no 它 that could be the model's search.

en: The ones you leave ticked get the words she searches for, not your files or your location. Exa also gets the addresses of pages it reads for her, and Parallel gets a random id for each conversation. They're free tiers that can change or stop, and Exa and Parallel may use searches to train their models, so keep names and addresses out of them. Behind them, Wikimedia (Wikivoyage and Wikipedia) and OpenStreetMap (Nominatim) are asked as a last resort, whatever you tick, when nothing else answers; Settings → Tools → Search via: Off stops that, and so does your model's own search, when the model has one.
